name: Northeast-10 Cross Country Championships
where: Bethpage, NY · Bethpage Polo at the Park
headline: Northeast-10 Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Southern Connecticut State swept the titles, the men with 41 points over Bentley (60) and the women with 25 over Bentley (70). Southern Connecticut’s Colton Sallum won the men’s race in 25:00.3 and Bentley’s Lily Tedford the women’s in 21:38.2.
